Name: Rahiel - A Genie NPC Bachelor (Vanilla and SVE)
Author: jierishi
Description:
[b][center][size=6]Rahiel – Custom NPC[/size][/center][/b]
Rahiel is a fully custom NPC for Stardew Valley: a genie with a mysterious past, a strong personality, and a lot to say. Designed to (hopefully) feel like a natural part of the game world.

[center][b][u]He is a later(ish)-game NPC.

[/u][/b][/center][center]How to unlock:
 [spoiler]Donate 60 artifacts to the Museum.
See Gunther's 'RustyKey' event. (Event ID : 66(base) or 103042015(SVE))
Unlock Mr. Qi's Club with the Club Card. (Event ID : RahielUnlocked)[/spoiler]

6 events tailored to specific maps (Beach, Club, Desert, Railroad, Town).
[size=2]Vanilla map version and SVE version both available in downloads.[/size][/center][center][size=5][/size][/center]

Comes with:
[list]
[*]Custom dialogue for all seasons, weather, heart levels, and festivals
[*]12 heart events with choices that shape the story
[*]Marriage support, including a custom spouse room, unique schedules, and post-marriage dialogue
[*]Gift tastes with personalized reactions and birthday lines
[*]Choice of 'Bearded' or 'Clean Shaven' portrait and sprite.
[/list]
To be added - Festival appearance after 6 Heart event, Island Resort
See posts for requests or known bugs.

Downloads.Description: Heart event causing major glitches. Removed Rahiel's 7th heart event until further notice.
